name: Fastino-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-Healthcare
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-BF16 (config.json max_position_embeddings 1048576). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
activation: relu2 (MLP and MoE); silu in the Mamba-2 path
attention_variant: hybrid Mamba-2 + LatentMoE + GQA: 40 Mamba-2, 40 MoE, 8 attention (of 88 blocks); vision via C-RADIO v4-H
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-BF16, not a new base model: same config.json, same 123.611 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-10-14. Caveats: recorded as text-generation, NOT vision-language - the card states 'Modalities: Text (the vision encoder of the VL base is not included)', so only the language backbone ships. Trained from the Nemotron 3.5 Super VL EARLY-ACCESS checkpoint (not the released BF16 base named in the field), LoRA rank 32, single training run, and the release is the merged checkpoint. In-domain and transfer tables are both the vendor's own harness; the card calls it a research model and explicitly not a medical device. Licence apache-2.0.

benchmarks.name: PubMedQA (test, n=500)
benchmarks.config: Card table 'Benchmark | Evaluation scope | Nemotron base | Fastino-Healthcare': 70.20% vs 77.60% (+7.40 pp). Same early-access checkpoint, same inputs/prompts/decoding/evaluator per row.
